features.name: Expense agent with AI-driven categorization
features.description: AI-driven expense management agent that provides auto-categorization based on LLM and automated collection of expense information. Provides significantly more functionality and automation than the non-agent version.
caveats: Currently not enabled in all regions
Agent not used in this demo

features.name: Expense collection and itemization
features.description: Collect expenses, add itemization details, guest information for entertainment events. Can be used with or without agent.
caveats: Without agent: must start with expense report first, not direct expense entry
Attachments and OCR extraction not available without agent

features.name: Expense approval workflow
features.description: Approval process for expense reports with straightforward approval already existing in Business Central. With agent: checks compliance against human-language company policies.
caveats: Without agent: basic approval only
With agent: can validate against document policies in natural language

features.name: Credit card provider integration
features.description: Connection with credit card providers to collect expense information and reconcile with existing expenses.
caveats: Not yet in public preview
Agent-dependent feature

features.name: Expense management rules
features.description: Rules engine supporting straightforward configuration of minimum and maximum amounts, spending thresholds requiring justification, and daily rate per diem. Rules require absolute accuracy.
caveats: Without agent: only basic rules, not policies
Agent version offers policies for more complex validation

features.name: Per diem configuration by location
features.description: Configure per diem amounts by country, city, and province. Supports multiple per diem calculation methods: none, full calendar day, overnight stay, 24-hour rolling period, with configurable minimum hours.
caveats: Requires expense location setup with country and region codes
Multiple calculation methods available for different compliance needs

features.name: Expense payment methods
features.description: Defines reimbursement type: employee-paid (reimbursable), private credit card, company credit card, or company bank account. Determines whether expense is reimbursable or expensed only.
caveats: Reimbursable only if employee paid with own money
Company card or account paid expenses are expensed but not reimbursed

features.name: Expense categories with itemization controls
features.description: Configure expense categories with optional itemization, participants, per diem, and mileage requirements. Support for subcategories and expense groups.
caveats: Optional itemization can be required per category

features.name: Expense posting groups
features.description: Two posting group types: expense posting groups for detail lines and employee posting groups for expense report header.

features.name: Refundable vs reimbursable expense distinction
features.description: Expenses can be marked refundable or non-refundable based on policy compliance. Refundable expenses posted to GL; non-refundable are tracked but not posted, allowing recovery from employee. Reimbursable only applies to employee-paid expenses.
caveats: Default set at category or subcategory level
Can be overridden at line level with appropriate permissions
Users may not know refundability status until after submission

features.name: Mileage reimbursement with standard rate
features.description: Reimbursement for using private cars for business purposes, calculated as a standard rate multiplied by kilometers or miles used.
caveats: Configured as part of allowance settings

features.name: Minimum hours for per diem
features.description: Configurable minimum hours threshold for full per diem eligibility; employees spending less than the minimum are not reimbursed.
caveats: Configuration is per rule setup

features.name: Partial per diem rules
features.description: Configure partial per diem eligibility when minimum hours threshold not met. Options: flat percentage of full rate or calculation based on eligible hours.
caveats: Requires per diem calculation method set to 24-hour rolling period or similar

features.name: Per diem reductions
features.description: Company can reduce per diem reimbursement if employee already has receipts for meals or if meals are included in other expenses like hotel stays.
caveats: Reductions are configurable per meal type

features.name: Expense users setup
features.description: All system users must be set up as expense users and connected to employees to collect employee posting group information.
caveats: Requires employee connection for posting groups

features.name: Expense participants
features.description: For business meals and entertainment, employees must provide a list of participant names; participants can be internal employees or external attendees.

features.name: Attachment enforcement
features.description: Configurable attachment requirements: optional, warning, or error if receipts are missing from expenses.

features.name: Expense groups
features.description: Optional grouping of expenses for easier analysis and reporting of expense entries.
caveats: Not mandatory

features.name: Expense subcategories
features.description: Subcategories provide itemized expense breakdown and can override default descriptions or mark items as non-refundable.
caveats: Required if itemization is needed

features.name: Expense locations
features.description: Define expense locations by geographic area (city, region, country) to apply different per diem rates and rules based on location.
caveats: Flexible definition by city or region

features.name: Expense management rules
features.description: Define rules linking expense categories, locations, and currency to daily rates and spending limits with optional justification requirements.

features.name: Expense refundability toggle
features.description: Expenses can be marked as refundable or non-refundable; when paid by card, reimbursed amount is zero, but when paid by cash the full amount is reimbursable.

features.name: Project expense linking
features.description: Expenses can be linked to specific projects and project tasks; linked expenses automatically update project ledger entries.

features.name: Customer billing of expenses
features.description: Expenses can be marked as billable to customers; when posted, the system automatically creates a sales invoice to the customer.

features.name: Automatic mileage calculation
features.description: System automatically calculates mileage expense amount based on starting point, ending point, kilometers or miles, and standard rate.

features.name: Multi-currency expense conversion
features.description: Expenses in foreign currencies are automatically converted to the database currency using system exchange rates during posting.

features.name: Per diem interactive details
features.description: Interactive per diem breakdown showing daily amounts, with ability to record actual meal expenses and system recalculates reduced per diem.

features.name: Expense category-based requirements
features.description: Expense categories can be configured to require specific information such as itemization for hotels, participant details for entertainment events, and additional per diem information.

features.name: Expense report generation
features.description: Create expense reports from individual expenses; get expense lines similar to get receipt lines in purchase process; all amounts recalculated and grouped by payment method.
caveats: Automatic if using expense agent, manual otherwise

features.name: Credit card payment tracking
features.description: System tracks which expenses were paid by company credit card versus employee, showing reimbursable amounts separately from amounts covered by credit card.

features.name: Rule violations detection
features.description: System detects rule violations when posting expense reports, preventing posting until violations are resolved. Same rules apply across web app and other sources of access.
caveats: rule violations block posting

features.name: Expense ledger entries
features.description: Posted expense reports create general ledger entries, expense ledger entries, and employee ledger entries for full audit trail.

features.name: Itemization requirement validation
features.description: System enforces itemization requirements for specified expense categories, preventing posting until itemized amounts equal the total expense amount.
caveats: itemization lines must total exactly to expense amount

features.name: Dynamic participant field generation
features.description: When selecting expense categories like morale event that require participant information, system dynamically adds participant fields that must be populated.

features.name: Manual vs agent expense report workflows
features.description: With expense agent, users can start with expenses and automatically convert to reports. Without agent, users must start with expense report and add lines directly.
